plub.title: What I do at Plub
paragraphs: I'm a Senior Data Engineer at Plub. I design and run the company's data platform: an AWS lakehouse that takes in data from different systems, organizes it, and makes it ready for reporting and analysis.

The work ranges from building reusable ingestion frameworks, so adding a new source is a matter of configuration instead of new code, to orchestrating pipelines with Airflow, modeling with dbt, and keeping everything running in production without surprises.
plub.highlightsTitle: What that looks like in practice
highlights: We moved from always-on servers to a serverless architecture, with lower fixed costs and less maintenance.
Pipelines have tests, alerts and retries, so problems get caught before they reach a report.
Data access runs on tag-based permissions: each team sees what it should without waiting on a ticket.
Transformations live in dbt, versioned and documented, instead of scattered one-off queries.

timeline.text: Multi-domain AWS lakehouse, ingestion frameworks, Airflow, dbt and data governance.
Event-driven ingestion pipelines on an AWS data lake, including Central Bank datasets. Orchestration with Airflow, plus monitoring.
AWS data lake infrastructure for digital products, and automated data quality checks.
Microservices and APIs for fintech applications, identity verification (KYC) and fraud checks.
Founded and ran a small software studio.
